description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 4.10 in the OrangeHRM installer, specifically for the 'V4_10_0' migration namespace. The class extends an abstract migration class and contains method definitions for 'up' (which currently performs no database changes) and 'getVersion' (which returns '4.10').

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class for version 4.10, extends AbstractMigration, provides methods to perform the migration and retrieve version info.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Implements the up method to define database changes for this migration; currently, no changes are made.
